race.comment: LAA DE SHA (6) started favourite but gave away too much start and couldn't peg back THE STALKER over 1250m at the Parks track last start. Strips fitter and enjoys a 4.5kgs weight drop. Callow to ride so plenty to like about his chances. LIKE A DRIFTER (7) started in the red when fresh from a spell over this course and distance four weeks ago but found HOLY RACKET a little too good after looking to have every chance. Better for that outing and beautifully drawn so he can repay backers. HOLY RACKET (4) raced on the pace and beat LIKE A DRIFTER fair and square when they clashed here four weeks ago. Racing in great heart and should get every favour from the inside alley. Can get the job done again. THE STALKER (2) was dominant over LAA DE SHA last time out. Free roller who will be prominent for a long way.
